name: Pillarstone Capital REIT
summary: Paragon Real Estate Equity and Investment Trust (PRLE) currently maintains a minimal operational presence. Instead, its core business strategy revolves around the meticulous identification and evaluation of diverse real estate investment possibilities. These prospects encompass a wide array of sectors, such as new land developments, commercial properties including retail, office, and industrial spaces, as well as hotels. Furthermore, PRLE considers investments in other real estate entities, operational businesses, and various joint venture undertakings. The company was established in 1994 and is headquartered in Houston, Texas, with a supplementary office located in Cleveland, Ohio.
